settings.content:
Center for Balanced Living is a trauma-informed psychological practice in Townsend, Delaware, offering therapy, psychological evaluations, supervision, consultation, and educational programming. Our work is grounded in nervous system awareness, somatic processing, relational attunement, and evidence-based care. We believe healing happens in relationship and that every person deserves support that is thoughtful, individualized, and responsive to where they are in the process.

Certifications and advanced training that influence our therapeutic style

settings.title: Licensed & Credentialed
settings.text: Led by Dr. Angela (Niki) Serravalle, PsyD, LPCMH, NCC, a practicing licensed psychologist.

settings.title: Trauma-Informed
settings.text: Advanced training in EMDR, TF-CBT, DBT, ACT, IFS, CPT, and ecotherapy.

settings.title: Assessment Expertise
settings.text: Specialized training in psychological evaluation, neurodevelopment, and diagnostic clarity.

settings.title: Ongoing Development
settings.text: Committed to continuing education and the highest standards of clinical care.

settings.title: A Dedicated Team
settings.text: Every team member shares a commitment to warmth, professionalism, and clinical excellence.

settings.title: Relational Care
settings.text: Care that honors the whole person, not just the symptom.

settings.heading: We're glad to talk
settings.body: Reach out for a consultation or to learn more about how we work.
